import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

from rlberry.envs.bandits import BernoulliBandit
from rlberry.agents.bandits import (
    UCB,
    UCBV,
    ETC,
    MOSS,
    IMED,
    NPTS,
    EXP3
)
from rlberry.wrappers import WriterWrapper
from rlberry.manager import ExperimentManager

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Problem parameters
n_arms = 5
means = [0.1, 0.5, 0.3, 0.7, 0.6]
T = 1000  # Horizon
n_fit = 1  # Number of fits per agent

# Create environment
env_ctor = BernoulliBandit
env_kwargs = dict(p=means)

# Agent parameters
agent_classes = [
    ("UCB", UCB),
    ("UCBV", UCBV),
    ("ETC", ETC),
    ("MOSS", MOSS),
    ("IMED", IMED),
    ("NPTS", NPTS),
    ("EXP3", EXP3)
]

agent_kwargs = {
    "UCB": dict(bandit_env_kwargs=env_kwargs),
    "UCBV": dict(bandit_env_kwargs=env_kwargs),
    "ETC": dict(bandit_env_kwargs=env_kwargs, horizon=T),
    "MOSS": dict(bandit_env_kwargs=env_kwargs),
    "IMED": dict(bandit_env_kwargs=env_kwargs),
    "NPTS": dict(bandit_env_kwargs=env_kwargs, prior="uniform"),
    "EXP3": dict(bandit_env_kwargs=env_kwargs, gamma=0.07)
}

# Experiment managers
managers = []
for name, agent_cls in agent_classes:
    agent_manager = ExperimentManager(
        agent_cls,
        (env_ctor, env_kwargs),
        agent_kwargs[name],
        fit_budget=T,
        n_fit=n_fit,
        parallelization="none",
        agent_name=name,
        wrappers=[WriterWrapper]
    )
    managers.append(agent_manager)

# Train agents
for manager in managers:
    manager.fit()

# Collect results
regrets = {}
pseudo_regrets = {}
actions = {}

optimal_mean = np.max(means)
for manager in managers:
    writer_data = manager.get_writer_data()
    rewards = np.array(writer_data["reward"])
    actions_taken = np.array(writer_data["action"])
    cum_rewards = np.cumsum(rewards)
    cum_regret = np.cumsum(optimal_mean - rewards)
    cum_pseudo_regret = np.cumsum(optimal_mean - np.array([means[a] for a in actions_taken]))
    regrets[manager.agent_name] = cum_regret
    pseudo_regrets[manager.agent_name] = cum_pseudo_regret
    actions[manager.agent_name] = actions_taken

# Plotting
sns.set(style="whitegrid")
colors = sns.color_palette("tab10", n_colors=len(agent_classes))
linestyles = ['-', '--', '-.', ':', (0, (3, 1, 1, 1)), (0, (5, 1)), (0, (1, 1))]

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))
for idx, (name, _) in enumerate(agent_classes):
    plt.plot(pseudo_regrets[name], label=name, color=colors[idx], linestyle=linestyles[idx])
plt.xlabel("Time step")
plt.ylabel("Cumulative Pseudo-Regret")
plt.title("Cumulative Pseudo-Regret of Bandit Agents")
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))
for idx, (name, _) in enumerate(agent_classes):
    plt.plot(regrets[name], label=name, color=colors[idx], linestyle=linestyles[idx])
plt.xlabel("Time step")
plt.ylabel("Cumulative Regret")
plt.title("Cumulative Regret of Bandit Agents")
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))
arm_counts = np.zeros((len(agent_classes), n_arms))
for idx, (name, _) in enumerate(agent_classes):
    for arm in range(n_arms):
        arm_counts[idx, arm] = np.sum(actions[name] == arm)
bar_width = 0.1
x = np.arange(n_arms)
for idx, (name, _) in enumerate(agent_classes):
    plt.bar(x + idx * bar_width, arm_counts[idx], width=bar_width, color=colors[idx], label=name)
plt.xlabel("Arm")
plt.ylabel("Number of times selected")
plt.title("Number of times each arm was selected")
plt.xticks(x + bar_width * (len(agent_classes) - 1) / 2, [f"Arm {i}" for i in range(n_arms)])
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
